scene.ko: 토요일 친구와의 저녁 약속을 집안 행사 때문에 바꿔야 해서, 전화로 사정을 말하고 새 날짜를 정한다.

lines.en: Hey, Josh, do you have a sec? It's about Saturday.
lines.ko: 조시, 잠깐 통화 돼? 토요일 일 때문에.
alt: Hi, Josh. Got a minute? I need to talk to you about Saturday.

lines.en: Sure. We're still on for dinner, right? I booked a table for seven.
lines.ko: 응. 저녁 약속 그대로지? 7시로 자리 예약해 놨어.

lines.en: That's actually why I'm calling. My family moved my grandma's 80th birthday dinner to Saturday, so I have to go to Daejeon. I'm really sorry to do this to you.
lines.ko: 사실 그래서 전화했어. 가족들이 할머니 팔순 식사를 토요일로 옮겨서 대전에 가야 하거든. 이렇게 돼서 정말 미안해.
alt: Well, that's the thing. My grandma's 80th birthday dinner got moved to Saturday, and I need to be in Daejeon. I hate to do this, but I have to cancel.

lines.en: Oh, bummer. But hey, family comes first. Don't worry about it.
lines.ko: 아, 아쉽다. 그래도 가족이 먼저지. 신경 쓰지 마.

lines.en: Thanks for understanding. Could we push it back to next weekend? Would Sunday work for you?
lines.ko: 이해해 줘서 고마워. 다음 주말로 미룰 수 있을까? 일요일 괜찮아?
alt: I appreciate it. Can we reschedule for next weekend? How does Sunday sound?

lines.en: Hmm, Sunday's tough. I've got a work thing. What about Friday night?
lines.ko: 음, 일요일은 좀 힘들어. 회사 일이 있거든. 금요일 밤은 어때?

lines.en: Friday works for me. I'll call the restaurant and move the reservation, since I'm the one changing plans.
lines.ko: 금요일 좋아. 내가 약속을 바꾼 거니까, 식당에 전화해서 예약 옮길게.
alt: Friday is good. Let me call the restaurant and change the booking.

lines.en: Are you sure? It's no big deal. I can do it.
lines.ko: 진짜? 별거 아닌데. 내가 해도 돼.

lines.en: No, really, let me handle it. And dinner's on me this time.
lines.ko: 아니야, 진짜 내가 할게. 그리고 이번 저녁은 내가 살게.
alt: It's fine, I've got it. And this time, dinner's my treat.

lines.en: Ha, now I'm kind of glad you canceled! Say happy birthday to your grandma for me.
lines.ko: 하하, 이러니까 취소해 준 게 좀 고마운데? 할머니께 생신 축하드린다고 전해 줘.

expressions.en: I'm really sorry to do this to you.
Could we push it back to ___?
expressions.note: push back = 뒤로 미루다 · 앞당기다는 move up
